quote: I have been extremely impressed with Haley Custom Homes. As I meet each week with Dan and his team, I always walk away confident that not only am I getting a very high quality home, but one where every detail is discussed and analyzed, as if it was a home they were building for themselves. One large attraction to Haley Custom Homes was that they said they could build it 33 percent faster than their competitors, with superior quality, because of their Accelerated Precision Building System. We were in the house a month earlier than scheduled. This is my third time building a custom home, and I have never been more satisfied.
name: Michael and Jane McDonald

quote: After interviewing many builders, we selected Dan Fuller and Haley Custom Homes for their reputation for fine craftsmanship, attention to detail, and a long history of completing projects on time and on budget. Their construction methods allowed the job to be delivered on the original delivery date, no small feat during the pandemic. The Haley team was extremely easy to work with. They don't just build houses. They create magnificent homes.
name: Bill Fisher

quote: We worked with Haley Custom Homes on an extensive remodel in the Country Club neighborhood. Dan is a pleasure to work with. Communication was excellent throughout the entire project. The attention to detail was excellent. We would love to work with the team again.
name: Traci and Tom Gendron
